bio: After hosting an award-winning radio show in university and beginning his professional career with the SiriusXM Fantasy Sports station as a Producer, Dylan wanted to combine his love for both fantasy sports and the Oscar race. He helped create the Fantasy Filmball platform, and in the years since, has brought his unique perspectives on film criticism, awards prognostication, and community-building to the space... crafting a platform for thoughtful conversation among like-minded individuals. Follow Dylan on Awards Expert: @FantasyFilmball
name: Dylan McKercher
